{{Quote|With these new battle droids we've built for you, you'll have the finest army in the galaxy.|[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The '''Separatist Droid Army''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] that was created and used by the [[Confederacy military/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in an effort to secure power throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It comprised [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|army]], [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union's]] [[Techno Union Droid Army/Legends|army]] and other corporations that allied themselves with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist movement]]. By the end of the Clone Wars it was said to be comprised of quintillions of battle droids.

The Separatist army had several skilled commanders in charge of various campaigns through the Clone Wars&mdash;most notably [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Fenn Shysa]], informal leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and [[Durge/Legends|Durge]].

==History==
===Formation of the Confederacy of Independent Systems===
{{Quote|Our droid armies outnumber the Republic clones 100 to 1.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]]|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
What would ultimately become a Separatist army originally began as several immense forces comprised almost exclusively of droids.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> When merged, these formed a colossal army numbering in the quintillions.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: Incredible Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_Geonosis.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] Army's first engagement at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].]]
The land elements encompassed an enormous ground force which comprised battle droids and ground attack vehicles. The ground forces utilized many vehicles, such as the [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|Heavy Missile Platform]], the [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire'' droid tank]], and the aquatic [[Manta droid subfighter]]. The Droid Army also employed a large space force, with a number of different types of [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], such as [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'' droid]] starfighter. The various services were eventually reorganized into the Separatist Droid Army by Count Dooku. Dooku would eventually deploy the new Separatist army to overthrow the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the Clone Wars<ref name="Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>&mdash;it was countered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary" />

This droid army drew upon of the battle droids of the Trade Federation,<ref name="Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary" /> the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]],<ref name="DB-Techno Union">{{DB|organization|technounion|Techno Union}}</ref> the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]],<ref name="DB-Commerce Guild">{{DB|organization|ca_tankdroid|Commerce Guild}}</ref> the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]],<ref name="Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary" /> the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]],<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary" /> and other independent Separatist factions. These groups were subtly manipulated by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to expand their forces in response to seemingly random attacks of [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] from groups like the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], which were also controlled by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. A number of assassinations then left these groups with leaders that Darth Sidious could control.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

Under his orders, these corporate giants began to purchase huge orders of battle droids from the millions of factories controlled by companies such as [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]], [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]], and [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]] over a decade before the start of the Clone Wars.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> While the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Neimoidia]] provided an inkling of what was to come, it was not until Count Dooku deployed over a billion [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] that the Republic understood the scope of the threat, thus the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had begun.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" />

While the Confederacy had an enormous number of soldiers, they initially lacked proper military leadership. Command of the army was initially given to Count Dooku's protégé Sev'rance Tann, a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] general, whose penchant for personal combat made her a counter to the Jedi. However, she was killed early on in the war by [[Echuu Shen-Jon]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> She was soon replaced by the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] known as General Grievous. After proving to Count Dooku that his cybernetic enhancements were sufficient by [[Mission to Trenchant space station|defeating]] Asajj Ventress and Durge aboard the [[Space Station Trenchant/Legends|Space Station Trenchant]], Grievous was formally awarded the title of [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]].<ref name="The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>. Other commanders besides Ventress and Durge were [[Fenn Shysa]], [[Spar]], and [[Alto Stratus]], who held lesser commands in various battles through the war.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Our friends from the Trade Federation have pledged their support. And when their battle droids are combined with yours, we shall have an army greater than any in the galaxy. The Jedi will be overwhelmed. The Republic will agree to any demands we make.|Count Dooku|<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" />}}
[[File:Hypori_droids.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]].]]
Backed by the millions of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] comprising the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], the Separatists challenged the rule of the Republic across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], beginning in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], with the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: Incredible Cross-Sections" /> Though initially overwhelmed as of the start of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Separatist forces had grown in strength by the time of the [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|Mission to Vjun]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] to the point where Count Dooku questioned the need for continual subterfuge between the governments and thought the Separatists could simply win outright.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

The strategy of the Separatists could be thought of as exceptionally defensive&mdash;their deployment at the start of the war was designed to deflect any attack on their territory, while they continued to build up the strength of their military. Though this frustrated some Republic [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]] such as [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], it also allowed the Republic time to muster its own forces to challenge the Separatists&mdash;exactly as Darth Sidious intended. The first offensive moves on the part of the Confederacy sought not immediate victory, but instead to deny the Republic advantages and sow fear among the civilians. They also sought to discredit or kill those on the Confederate side who would end the war too swiftly.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

During this time, the Confederacy instead worked on projects such as chemical weapons like [[swamp gas]], [[Trihexalophine1138]], and a clone-targeting nanovirus.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic">''[[Star Wars: Republic]]''</ref> However, since no army won by retreating, the Confederacy was soon on the move, seizing planets left and right in a string of victories. After his existence was officially revealed to Republic forces at the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of]] [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]],<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''</ref> General Grievous became known as the architect of the Separatists' victories&mdash;on his orders, he brought about by his hatred for the Republic and the modifications to his mind, the army was responsible for immense amounts of carnage and destruction. The Clone Wars saw the devastation of over a thousand worlds, including [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]], [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]], and [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]]. These horrors, perpetrated by droids and alien species, led to much of the prejudice that ruled the galaxy a generation later.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />

[[File:B-series_battle_droids.jpg|thumb|left|400px|[[Firefighter droid/Legends|Firefighter droid]], [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droid]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]], [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA series super battle droid]] and a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]]]]

The Clone Wars was essentially one giant game against the galaxy, and, like every game, it had a closing move. Desperate to throw the Jedi off his trail, Darth Sidious ordered General Grievous to carry out an [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Hundreds of millions of droids swarmed the planet, successfully distracting the Jedi from their search. The attack was a ruse to draw [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] over to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and eliminate Count Dooku. While initially successful, the battle ended in a rout when Generals [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] and Skywalker arrived with the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] and defeated the Separatist while rescuing the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>

The defeat did not end there, though, as days later Kenobi [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|killed]] Grievous on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and Darth Vader&mdash;formerly Anakin Skywalker&mdash;[[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|executed]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. After completing his murder spree, Vader used the [[master control signal]] to transmit the order to deactivate all the Confederate droids across the galaxy in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. On planets as distant as [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], the droids simply deactivated immediately when the order was relayed, much to the confusion of the commanders, thus bringing an official end to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />

===Separatist holdouts Conflicts===
{{Quote|All by his lonesome, he'd found a previously hidden droid factory, fired it up and cranked out his own private army of battle droids.|From the [[501st Journal]], about Gizor Dellso|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}
[[File:Destroyer_Droid.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].]]
The new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was swift to absorb the remnants of the Separatist Droid Army into their ranks, including the [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] of the Commerce Guild, the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]], and the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] of the Trade Federation, as well as crab droids and B1s. These units were used to force the once-Separatists strongholds to join the Galactic Empire. Many [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]] and [[B3 ultra battle droid]]s found their way to [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], where they were used to help train [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Many [[Scorpenek annihilator droid/Legends|Scorpenek annihilator droids]] were studied by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] before being shipped to the [[Emperor's Citadel|Emperor's citadel]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

However, not all Separatist droids became parts of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. Some worlds, such as [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]], still used battle droids against the new Empire and refused to surrender, thus resulting in the formation of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Also, the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Gizor Dellso]] reactivated a portion of the army on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] around [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], requiring the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|storm]] the planet afterward. This resulted in a large [[Geonosian Industries/Legends|faction]] of the Separatist holdouts to fall, thus resulting in a fragmentation of the [[Confederacy]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used Hailfire tanks to siege various cities across different planets<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Also, a few droid units would be recovered and re-programmed by various beings, such as the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]], who would later use a droideka during their attempted destruction of the remains of [[Outbound Flight Project|''Outbound Flight'']], years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> Other independent factions were able to seize some droids for their own purposes on a number of occasions. Notable examples would be the B2 battle droids that later became the famous [[Orange Panthacs]],<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> the slaughter of an Imperial garrison on [[Jaguada's moon]] after a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] reactivated the leftover droids there,<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> or the use of [[droideka Mark II]]s by [[Tyber Zann]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

Some droids were not shut down. The droids of Geonosis did not require a control ship to activate and deactivate, as discovered by [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] during the Battle of Geonosis. Therefore, the droid "[[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|leftovers]]" from Geonosis survived the deactivation. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] found this out the hard way after his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] crashed on Geonosis during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> Following the Rebel's retreat from the planet, the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] utterly [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]] whatever was left of the droids, along with the last surviving [[Core ship/Legends|Core Ship]] in existence, one of the sole remaining strongholds of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], Even though a majority of the Separatist organizations were dissolved, many former relics of their influence remained for decades following the Galactic Civil War from crashed droid pods to forgotten foundries around multiple systems of the Outer Rim.

===Post-Confederacy and Independence===
Following the dissolution of the Separatist holdouts, some droids were not shut down, but managed to form their own societies. On [[Arzid]], a squad of [[E4 baron droid]]s overthrew the existing government to rule the settlement. Surviving [[A-series assassin droid]]s returned to the wilds of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. There was also a case where several dozen [[Manta droid subfighter]]s founded a colony on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], where they formed a symbiotic relationship with some native [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Jedi [[Klin-Fa Gi]] along with [[Uldir Lochett]] encountered a type of drone on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] that had somehow not been deactivated, it is possible it was a [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]].<ref name="Emissary of the Void">"[[Emissary of the Void]]"</ref> Some groups of sentient vulture droids were spotted in remote systems.

==Organization==
[[File:Grievous-on-Vandos.jpg|left|thumb|300x330px|Grievous served as the supreme commander of the CIS Droid Army.]]
The Separatist Droid Army was a massive, eclectic mix of droids, organic soldiers, vehicles and aircraft drawn from the various systems and corporate organizations that had declared for the Confederacy, including the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], the [[Techno Union Droid Army/Legends|Techno Union Droid Army]], the [[Commerce Guild Punitive Security Forces/Legends|Commerce Guild Punitive Security Forces]], the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IGBC]] [[Collections and Security Division/Legends|Collections and Security Division]], and the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Corporate Alliance Policy Administration Directorate/Legends|Policy Administration Directorate]]. At the onset of the war, each had its own [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]], which were reorganized by General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to fit more closely with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] model. Grievous assembled ''ad hoc'' [[Task force/Legends|task forces]] and armies from those available to him. While each commercial faction had its own military leader, as did local forces pledging loyalty to the Confederacy, they all reported to Grievous.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The basic tactical unit was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of 8 battle droids. Seven squads made a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of 56 droids. [[Company/Legends|Companies]] were composed of two platoons, making 112 battle droids, plus support droids, transported via either a [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]], [[Platoon Attack Craft/Legends|Attack Craft]], or equivalent. [[Battalion/Legends|Battalions]] were composed to 784 battle droids and support droids in seven troop carrier companies, plus a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of 24 [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] or equivalent.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

[[File:B1sAndB2sOnRyloth-TCWS03E03.png|thumb|right|261px|B1 and B2 battle droids attack on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]]]
Above the battalion level, [[Vanguard (droid army)|vanguards]] sat between battalions and [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] in size and were designed to break through heavy defences. They were composed of 1,232 battle droids and support droids and consisted of eleven MTT companies and a squadron of 18 [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]]. Regiments consisted of 4,368 droids and support troops in four battalions and a single vanguard, and were the total number of troops and vehicles carried aboard one [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]]. [[Division/Legends|Divisions]] consisted of 21,840 droids in five regiments, while [[Corps/Legends|corps]] consisted of 109,200 droids in five divisions. The largest tactical unit was the [[Army/Legends|army]], composed of 218,000 battle droids and support droids in two corps, and represented the total surface force carried aboard a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Weapons==
Weapons used by the army included; [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]], [[SE-14 blaster pistol]]s, [[E-5s sniper rifle/Legends|E-5s sniper rifles]], [[V-1 thermal detonator]]s, [[HX2 antipersonnel mine|HX-2 antipersonnel mines]], [[TB-47 time bomb]]s, [[F-187 fusioncutter]]s. Heavy ordnance weapons like; the [[E-60R missile launcher]]s, [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launchers]], [[Bulldog RLR]], and the [[RD-4 grenade launcher]]s which fired unstable radiation grenades. [[Mark IV recon droid]]s were used as recon surveillance of the battlefield. [[Autoturret/Legends|Autoturrets]] were used to defend key positions.
